notes.title: Gate to Site 8 is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Gate to Site 8 has been released![/h1]

I'm happy to announce that you can now buy Gate to Site 8! 

It's a unique game that’s very loosely based on the Mothman urban legend, mixed with some inspiration from my own life. The legend has fascinated me for as long as I can remember, and making this game has been an amazing journey as a new indie dev.

Its companion game, Faded Grey (a promotional short), is also available on Steam for free: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1674770/Faded_Grey/]Faded Grey[/url]

Thank you all for your support and I hope you enjoy the journey.

Stay well,

Derek
